description: The read-only Home folds the same sealed hub directory pages into its own config store that the editor folds into its own (ticket 26/09/23 S16, audit s13 §6 #16). Each page is sealed by the SHA-256 of its canonical unsigned JSON; `spaces` are the SpaceCreated events it carries (seq, id, name). After every accepted page, both surfaces hold `expected`: the page frontier as cursor and the ordered space ids of the projection. `refused` pages must be refused by both surfaces without a config change.
